complete_source_unit.text:
def skip_battle?
    return true if $player.able_pokemon_count == 0
    return true if $DEBUG && Input.press?(Input::CTRL)
    return false
  end

  def skip_battle(outcome_variable, trainer_battle = false)
    pbMessage(_INTL("SKIPPING BATTLE...")) if !trainer_battle && $player.pokemon_count > 0
    pbMessage(_INTL("SKIPPING BATTLE...")) if trainer_battle && $DEBUG
    pbMessage(_INTL("AFTER WINNING...")) if trainer_battle && $player.able_pokemon_count > 0
    $game_temp.clear_battle_rules
    if $game_temp.memorized_bgm && $game_system.is_a?(Game_System)
      $game_system.bgm_pause
      $game_system.bgm_position = $game_temp.memorized_bgm_position
      $game_system.bgm_resume($game_temp.memorized_bgm)
    end
    $game_temp.memorized_bgm            = nil
    $game_temp.memorized_bgm_position   = 0
    $PokemonGlobal.nextBattleBGM        = nil
    $PokemonGlobal.nextBattleVictoryBGM = nil
    $PokemonGlobal.nextBattleCaptureME  = nil
    $PokemonGlobal.nextBattleBack       = nil
    $PokemonEncounters.reset_step_count
    outcome = 1   # Win
    outcome = 0 if trainer_battle && $player.able_pokemon_count == 0   # Undecided
    pbSet(outcome_variable, outcome)
    return outcome

premises: Ordinary fixed-R helper with normal global dependencies and callbacks.
Player has a nonempty party with zero able members; DEBUG false; no memorized BGM.
skip_battle? is true before the two helper calls; trainer_battle bool is the sole changed helper parameter.
observable_boundary: The helper passes different result values to pbSet and returns different values. No host game variable/display execution is claimed.
failure_partial_commit: Both variants may already display/clear rules/reset next-battle fields before pbSet; later exception is not rollback. Exact receiver execution remains NOT_EXECUTED.
why_finite: This is an overbroad parenthetical summary contradicted by its correct explicit result row. No missing skip algorithm, no wrong main outcome row, no reopening C0014 semantic no-battle definition.
suggested_minimal_change: Replace only the parenthesis with wording that acknowledges message and result branches, or remove it. Preserve current line113 and all concrete skip writes.
not_a_duplicate_of_known_candidates: COM001 Stall naming; COM002 zero-able wild participant size; COM003 mixed wild order; CRE001 EV clamp. Broader historical duplicate lookup still root-owned.
